items.hed: Colts beat the Texans 19-17 in Indianapolis
items.insight: NFL scoreboard, final Sunday: Houston lost at the Indianapolis Colts, 19-17, at Lucas Oil Stadium. The Texans are 0-3. The Colts are 1-2. Next on the club schedule is a home game Oct. 4 against Dallas, noon CT, FOX.

items.hed: Astros shut out the Athletics 9-0 and sit at .500
items.insight: MLB Stats API, final Sunday: Astros 9, Athletics 0, at Sutter Health Park. It was the series finale. Houston is 81-81. The Athletics are 64-98. No game on the Monday card at filing.

items.hed: Rockets media day was last week; the rest of the league reports today
items.insight: NBA.com key dates, updated Sept. 26: Sept. 28 is the first day the remaining 28 clubs may report, and media day for those clubs. The Rockets held media day Sept. 22. Training camps open Sept. 29. Houston meets Dallas in preseason at The Venetian Arena in Macao on Oct. 9 and Oct. 11. No NBA game today.
